about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/exportgen: edits of its source and of its regeneration entry (scripts/exportgen) that some test must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/exportgen; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it.

mutants.name: exportgen-entry-imports-check
mutants.rule: The regeneration entry builds no package it generates for, so a stale codec_access_gen.go cannot stop it.
